title: Voice Control with Vosk Speech Recognition
description: Implement voice control using Vosk speech recognition for hands-free workout control. Support commands like 'pause', 'resume', 'skip interval', 'end workout', and 'take lap'.

phases.name: Vosk Model Management
phases.description: Implement Vosk model download, installation, and initialization system

subtasks.title: Create Vosk model manager module
subtasks.description: Create src/voice/mod.rs and src/voice/model_manager.rs with VoskModelManager struct that handles model path resolution, storage location detection, and model state tracking. Use crate::storage::config::get_data_dir() for model storage path consistent with existing patterns.
subtasks.notes: Created src/voice/mod.rs and src/voice/model_manager.rs with VoskModelManager struct. Features: model path resolution using get_data_dir(), state tracking (Unknown/NotInstalled/Downloading/Extracting/Ready/Error), model validation, directory management, comprehensive tests. Committed as a16d530.

subtasks.title: Implement model download system
subtasks.description: Add async model download functionality using reqwest with progress tracking. Download vosk-model-small-en-us from official Vosk releases. Include SHA256 verification, extraction of zip file, and atomic move to final location.
subtasks.notes: Implemented async model download with progress tracking using reqwest. Features: streaming download with callback progress, SHA256 verification using sha2 crate, zip extraction with path traversal protection, atomic installation via rename with copy fallback. Added download.rs module with ModelDownloader, DownloadProgress, and DownloadError types. Integrated with VoskModelManager via download_model() and download_model_with_channel() methods. Added sha2, hex, zip dependencies to voice-control feature. Committed as 4ec312d.

subtasks.title: Add model initialization state machine
subtasks.description: Implement state machine for model lifecycle: Uninitialized -> Downloading -> Extracting -> Ready or Error. Emit events for UI progress updates. Handle resume of interrupted downloads.
subtasks.notes: Implemented ModelLifecycleStateMachine with: ModelLifecycleEvent enum for UI progress (StateChanged, DownloadProgress, ExtractionProgress, DownloadResuming, InstallationComplete, Error), event emission via callback or channel, PartialDownloadInfo for resume support, state transitions (NotInstalled->Downloading->Extracting->Ready/Error), methods (start_download, cancel_download, retry_download, refresh_state), and comprehensive unit tests. Committed as 02cae48.

phases.name: Vosk Recognition Engine
phases.description: Integrate Vosk speech recognition with audio input capture

subtasks.title: Create audio input capture module
subtasks.description: Create src/voice/audio_input.rs using cpal for cross-platform microphone access. Implement AudioInputCapture struct with start/stop methods, sample rate configuration (16kHz mono for Vosk), and ring buffer for audio samples.
subtasks.notes: Created src/voice/audio_input.rs with cross-platform microphone capture using cpal. Features: AudioInputCapture struct with start/stop methods, 16kHz mono configuration for Vosk, thread-safe AudioRingBuffer for sample storage, support for multiple sample formats (i16, f32, i8, i32, u8, u16, u32, f64), device enumeration, pause/resume functionality. Added cpal 0.15 to voice-control feature in Cargo.toml. Updated mod.rs with exports. Committed as 5da6ce7.

subtasks.title: Implement Vosk recognizer wrapper
subtasks.description: Create src/voice/recognizer.rs wrapping vosk::Recognizer. Initialize with model, configure for command recognition mode (not continuous transcription). Implement thread-safe wrapper since Vosk is not Send+Sync.
subtasks.notes: Created src/voice/recognizer.rs with ThreadSafeRecognizer wrapping vosk::Recognizer. Uses worker thread + channels pattern from ThreadSafeTtsProvider in audio/tts.rs. Features: RecognizerConfig with for_commands() method for workout command grammar, RecognitionResult with text/confidence, accept_waveform/partial_result/final_result/reset methods. Thread-safe (Send+Sync) via worker thread isolation. Committed as 471c14b.

subtasks.title: Build recognition pipeline
subtasks.description: Create src/voice/engine.rs VoiceEngine that orchestrates audio capture -> Vosk recognizer -> command parsing. Run on dedicated thread with channel-based communication. Handle partial and final results from Vosk.
subtasks.notes: Created src/voice/engine.rs with VoiceEngine that orchestrates audio capture -> Vosk recognizer -> command parsing. Runs on dedicated worker thread with channel-based communication. Handles partial and final results. Key types: VoiceEngine, VoiceEngineConfig, VoiceEngineEvent, VoiceEngineState. Supports pause/resume, confidence filtering, silence timeout, and grammar constraints.

phases.name: Command Recognition
phases.description: Parse recognized speech into workout commands with confidence scoring

subtasks.title: Enhance command parser with fuzzy matching
subtasks.description: Extend VoiceCommand::from_phrase() in accessibility/voice_control.rs with Levenshtein distance-based fuzzy matching for robustness. Add confidence scores and minimum threshold. Handle common misrecognitions.
subtasks.notes: Created src/voice/command_parser.rs with Levenshtein distance-based fuzzy matching. Features: CommandParser with configurable confidence thresholds (DEFAULT_MIN_CONFIDENCE = 0.6), ParseResult with command/confidence/matched_keyword, common misrecognition mappings (paws->pause, resoom->resume, starred->start, etc.), primary and secondary keyword support. Extended VoiceCommand::from_phrase() to use CommandParser when voice-control feature enabled, with fallback to simple matching. Added from_phrase_simple(), from_phrase_with_confidence(), and from_phrase_with_threshold() methods. Comprehensive unit tests included. Committed as 9b34e25.

subtasks.title: Add lap command support
subtasks.description: Add TakeLap variant to VoiceCommand enum. Map phrases like 'take lap', 'lap', 'mark lap' to this command. Update VoiceCommandHandler to translate to ButtonAction::AddLapMarker.
subtasks.notes: Added TakeLap variant to VoiceCommand enum. Mapped phrases 'take lap', 'lap', 'mark lap' to TakeLap command in both from_phrase_simple() and CommandParser::get_command_definitions(). Updated command_confirmation() to return "Marking lap" and command_audio_cue() to return Action cue. Added unit tests for lap command variations including misrecognitions (lab, lapp, lack). Leveraged existing MISRECOGNITION_MAP entries for lap. Committed as 33deeed.

subtasks.title: Implement command cooldown and debouncing
subtasks.description: Add cooldown timer to prevent rapid command repetition (e.g., 1 second between same commands). Implement debounce for brief silences during speech. Track last command and timestamp.
subtasks.notes:
Implemented command cooldown and debounce functionality:

- Added CommandCooldown struct in engine.rs with: is_allowed(), remaining_cooldown_ms(), record_command(), reset(), last_command(), time_since_last_command()
- Added cooldown config to VoiceEngineConfig: command_cooldown_ms (default 1000ms), debounce_ms (default 300ms), enable_cooldown (default true)
- Added builder methods: with_command_cooldown(), with_debounce(), with_cooldown_enabled()
- Added VoiceEngineEvent::CommandCooldown event for blocked commands
- Integrated cooldown check in process_final_result()
- Added debounce logic in worker thread using last_audio_activity tracking
- Updated VoiceCommandHandler with cooldown tracking: is_command_allowed(), remaining_cooldown_ms(), queue_command_with_cooldown(), reset_cooldown()
- Added comprehensive unit tests for all cooldown and debounce functionality

Committed as f11d4e1.

phases.name: Activation Modes
phases.description: Implement wake word and push-to-talk activation modes

subtasks.title: Implement always-on mode with wake word
subtasks.description: Add wake word detection in VoiceEngine. Detect 'Hey Rust Ride' or 'OK Ride' as wake phrases. Enter active listening mode for 5 seconds after wake word. Use keyword spotting from Vosk grammar.
subtasks.notes: Implemented wake word detection with WakeWordDetector supporting "Hey Rust Ride" and "OK Ride" phrases. Added ActivationMode enum (AlwaysListening, WakeWord, PushToTalk), integrated into VoiceEngine worker thread, and added wake word events (WakeWordDetected, WakeWordTimeout, WakeWordExtended, ActivationModeChanged). 5 second active listening timeout with extension support.

subtasks.title: Implement push-to-talk mode
subtasks.description: Add keyboard shortcut handler for push-to-talk (default: F4 key). When held, capture audio and recognize. When released, process final result. Support configurable key binding.
subtasks.notes:
Implemented push-to-talk keyboard shortcut handler:

- Created src/voice/push_to_talk.rs with PushToTalkHandler struct
- PushToTalkConfig supports configurable key binding (default: F4 key)
- PushToTalkKey wraps egui::Key for push-to-talk functionality
- State machine: Idle -> Pending -> Active -> Idle with proper transitions
- Min hold duration (100ms default) prevents accidental activations
- Max hold duration (30s default) auto-releases to prevent stuck states
- Events: Activated, Deactivated, Cancelled, TimedOut, KeyBindingChanged
- Thread-safe (Send + Sync) via AtomicBool and RwLock
- Added PushToTalk action to KeyAction enum in keyboard.rs
- Comprehensive unit tests included
- Committed as 1ee38ea

subtasks.title: Connect activation settings to config
subtasks.description: Wire VoiceActivation setting from AccessibilitySettings to VoiceEngine mode selection. Add runtime mode switching without restart. Persist selection to config.toml.
subtasks.notes:
Implemented VoiceActivation to VoiceEngine wiring:

- Added WakeWord variant to VoiceActivation enum (AlwaysOn, WakeWord, PushToTalk, Off)
- Added From trait implementations for bidirectional conversion between VoiceActivation (config) and ActivationMode (engine)
- Added VoiceControlSettings struct with is_active(), from_accessibility() helpers
- Added apply_voice_activation() method to VoiceEngine for runtime mode switching without restart
- Added voice_activation() getter and config_from_settings() factory method
- Added Display implementation for VoiceActivation
- Added comprehensive unit tests for conversions and settings

Settings are already persisted via AccessibilitySettings in config.toml. Committed as edfca74.

phases.name: Feedback System
phases.description: Provide audio and visual confirmation of recognized commands

subtasks.title: Implement audio feedback tones
subtasks.description: Create distinct tones for: wake word detected, command recognized, command failed. Use existing RodioAudioBackend::play_tone() with appropriate frequencies. Add to voice engine pipeline.
subtasks.notes:
Created src/voice/feedback.rs with audio feedback system for voice control events:

- VoiceFeedbackEvent enum: WakeWordDetected, CommandRecognized, CommandFailed, ListeningStarted, ListeningEnded, CooldownBlocked
- VoiceFeedbackConfig with enable/disable and volume controls
- VoiceFeedback struct using RodioAudioBackend::play_tone_with_volume()
- Frequencies: wake word ascending (440Hz->660Hz), command recognized (523Hz), command failed descending (600Hz->400Hz)
- Durations: wake word notes (80ms), command recognized (150ms), command failed notes (100ms)
- Both sync play() and async play_async() methods
- Updated mod.rs with exports

Committed as 5866f64.

subtasks.title: Add TTS confirmation of commands
subtasks.description: Use existing ThreadSafeTtsProvider to speak command confirmation (e.g., 'Pausing', 'Skipping interval'). Make TTS confirmation optional via settings. Prevent TTS during microphone capture to avoid feedback.
subtasks.notes: Added TTS confirmation support to VoiceFeedback: ThreadSafeTtsProvider integration, tts_confirmation and pause_mic_during_tts config options, speak_confirmation() methods (sync/async/with mic pause), play_command_with_confirmation() convenience method, microphone state tracking via AtomicBool. Uses VoskVoiceControl::command_confirmation() for text. Committed as fe29c7f.

subtasks.title: Integrate with visual feedback widget
subtasks.description: Connect VoiceEngine state changes to VoiceIndicator widget. Show listening animation during active capture. Display recognized command text briefly. Update confirmation popup with actual recognized text.
subtasks.notes:
Implemented VoiceIndicatorBridge to connect VoiceEngine events to VoiceIndicator widget:

- Added VoiceIndicatorBridge struct that subscribes to VoiceEngine events via broadcast channel
- Added VoiceIndicatorBridgeState for managing UI state with automatic timeouts
- Added From<VoiceEngineState> for VoiceIndicatorState for state mapping
- Added partial_text, recognized_text, wake_word_active fields to VoiceIndicator
- Added draw_partial_text_popup() for real-time recognition feedback with pulsing animation
- Added draw_recognized_text_popup() for showing final recognized text briefly (2s timeout)
- Enhanced listening animation with dual concentric pulsing circles when wake word is active
- Updated confirmation popup to show actual recognized command text (2.5s timeout)
- Added comprehensive unit tests for bridge state and indicator functionality
- Exported VoiceIndicatorBridge and VoiceIndicatorBridgeState from widgets module

Committed as 609d37a.

phases.name: Integration
phases.description: Connect voice commands to workout control and app lifecycle

subtasks.title: Map voice commands to button actions
subtasks.description: Create VoiceCommandExecutor that converts VoiceCommand to ButtonAction. Inject into existing action execution pipeline from hid/executor.rs. Handle context-sensitive commands (e.g., Skip only during workout).
subtasks.notes:
Implemented VoiceCommandExecutor that converts VoiceCommand to ButtonAction with context-sensitive validation:

- VoiceCommandExecutor struct with to_action(), map_with_context(), is_valid() methods
- ExecutorContext for tracking ride/workout state with builder pattern
- Context validation: Skip only during workout, Pause/Resume/End/TakeLap only during ride
- MappingResult providing action, required_context, validity, and error reason
- VoiceExecutorError with From<ActionError> conversion for pipeline integration
- Bidirectional From conversions between ExecutorContext and hid::executor::AppContext
- available_commands() to get valid commands for current context
- Comprehensive unit tests (35+ tests) covering all scenarios
- Exported from voice module: VoiceCommandExecutor, VoiceExecutorError, ExecutorContext, MappingResult

Committed as 383ba2e.

subtasks.title: Integrate VoiceEngine with app lifecycle
subtasks.description: Initialize VoiceEngine during app startup when voice-control feature enabled. Pause recognition during audio playback (TTS, sounds). Clean shutdown on app exit. Add to RustRideApp struct.
subtasks.notes: Integrated VoiceEngine into RustRideApp with full lifecycle management: initialization on app startup when voice-control feature enabled and Vosk model ready, event processing in update loop, audio playback coordination (pause/resume recognition during TTS), and clean shutdown on exit. Added Arc-returning methods to DefaultAudioEngine for VoiceFeedback integration.

subtasks.title: Add voice control settings UI
subtasks.description: Create settings panel for voice control: enable/disable toggle, activation mode selection, push-to-talk key binding, voice feedback toggle. Add model download button with progress indicator.
subtasks.notes:
Created src/ui/settings/voice_settings.rs with VoiceSettingsPanel widget following AudioSettingsPanel pattern:

- VoiceSettingsAction enum: SettingsChanged, DownloadModel, CancelDownload, ToggleVoiceControl, ChangeActivationMode, ChangePushToTalkKey, ToggleVoiceFeedback, ToggleTtsConfirmation
- VoiceSettings struct: enabled, activation_mode, push_to_talk_key, audio_feedback_enabled, tts_confirmation_enabled
- VoiceSettingsResponse: action, settings_changed
- VoiceSettingsPanelConfig: show_header, expanded, model_status, feature_available
- VoiceModelStatus enum: Unknown, NotInstalled, Downloading (with progress), Extracting, Ready, Error

Features:
- Enable/disable toggle for voice control
- Activation mode selection (Wake Word, Push-to-Talk, Always On, Off)
- Push-to-talk key binding dropdown (F4-F8, Space, Tab)
- Audio feedback toggle
- TTS confirmation toggle
- Model download button with progress bar
- Model status display
- Feature availability warning when voice-control not compiled

Updated src/ui/settings/mod.rs with voice_settings exports. Committed as 600950c.

phases.name: Testing and Polish
phases.description: Comprehensive testing and error handling improvements

subtasks.title: Add comprehensive unit tests
subtasks.description: Add unit tests for all voice modules: model manager, audio input (mocked), recognizer, command parser, feedback system. Target 80% code coverage for voice/ directory.
subtasks.notes: All voice modules have comprehensive unit test coverage with 314 tests total. Coverage includes: model_manager (65), download (30), audio_input (37), recognizer (13), command_parser (20), feedback (15), wake_word (25), push_to_talk (28), engine (52), executor (29). Tests cover all core functionality including mocked audio input for testing without hardware.

subtasks.title: Add integration tests
subtasks.description: Create integration tests simulating full voice command flow with pre-recorded audio samples. Test command accuracy with various accents and noise levels. Add to tests/voice_integration.rs.
subtasks.notes: Created comprehensive voice control integration tests in tests/integration/voice_integration_test.rs. Tests cover: (1) Command parsing accuracy for clear/accented/noisy/misrecognized speech, (2) Full voice command flow simulation with mock engine, (3) Wake word detection variations and misrecognitions, (4) Command cooldown integration, (5) Context-sensitive command execution, (6) Audio feedback integration, (7) End-to-end session simulation. Tests use mock components for CI compatibility without audio hardware.

subtasks.title: Improve error handling and user feedback
subtasks.description: Add user-friendly error messages for: no microphone, model download failed, recognition errors. Show troubleshooting hints. Add retry logic for transient failures.
subtasks.notes: Created comprehensive user-friendly error handling module at src/voice/error.rs with: VoiceControlError with user-friendly messages, platform-specific troubleshooting hints for Windows/macOS/Linux, error category classification (Microphone, ModelDownload, Recognition, Configuration, Network), error conversions from all voice error types, RetryConfig and RetryState for transient failure handling with exponential backoff and jitter. 50+ unit tests covering all functionality.

subtasks.title: Update Cargo.toml and lib.rs exports
subtasks.description: Add cpal dependency for voice-control feature. Update lib.rs to export voice module. Add conditional compilation for voice-control feature throughout. Update feature documentation.
subtasks.notes: Voice-control feature already defined in Cargo.toml, just needs cpal

acceptance_criteria.description: Vosk speech model downloads and initializes
acceptance_criteria.verification: Model downloads on first run with progress indicator, extracts to data directory, and initializes Vosk recognizer successfully
Commands 'pause', 'resume', 'skip', 'end workout', 'take lap', 'status' are recognized with >90% accuracy in quiet environment
Wake word 'Hey Rust Ride' triggers listening mode. Push-to-talk key (F4) captures audio while held. Mode selectable in settings
All recognition happens locally using Vosk. No network requests after model download. Works without internet connection
Audio tone confirms recognition. TTS speaks command confirmation. Visual indicator shows listening state and recognized command
